changelog.text:
### New
- Interactively drag and resize your logo directly on a preview frame of your video (Pro).
- Flip your video horizontally with the new Mirror Video option without reversing subtitles or logos.
- Easily reach support via Telegram, phone, or email using the new Contact Admin button.
- Choose how many videos to process in each run with the new batch size setting (Pro).
### Improved
- The video list now clearly notifies you how many videos remain after a batch completes so you can easily run the next set.
- Convenient contact links and your Machine ID are now shown directly on login and update windows.

### Improved
- Update checks are now more reliable when you click the check buttons.

### Improved
- Settings panel now automatically resizes to prevent any controls from being cut off at the edge.
- Layout and spacing of audio volume sliders and checkboxes have been streamlined.
- Scrollbars throughout the app have been given a cleaner, modern look.

### New
- 🔄 "Check for updates" button in the top bar.
- The app checks for a new version automatically when it opens and when you import videos.
### Improved
- Gemini: when one model or API key reaches its free limit, the app switches to the next one at once
  (no long waiting), with clearer messages.
- Clearer messages when the update server cannot be reached.

### New
- License plans with different features:
  - Standard: 1 Gemini API key (can be replaced), Gemini 3.1 models, one voice for the whole
    video (male or female), videos up to 2 minutes, 1 video at a time.
  - Pro: several API keys (switches automatically when one reaches its limit), all Gemini models
    with "Auto – best stable model", custom theme color, automatic male/female voice, video preview,
    logo on the video, Khmer subtitles on a blurred band over the original text, videos up to
    5 minutes, import a whole folder, up to 10 videos per run, fast generate, .srt export.
  - Trial: all Pro features for 3 days.
- Logo on video: choose image, corner, size and transparency (Pro).
- Khmer subtitles on a blurred band that hides the original burned-in text (Pro).
- ⚡ Fast generate: more voice lines in parallel and the fastest video encoding (Pro).
### Improved
- Clear messages when a video is too long or a feature needs a Pro license.

### New
- Automatic updates: the app checks for new versions at every start.
- Pro licenses update with one click ("Update now"); the update is verified before it is installed.
- Trial licenses get updates during the trial; Standard licenses keep the version they bought.
- "What's new" window after each update and a 📝 What's new button for the full history.
- Separate developer and customer apps (developer data is kept apart).
### Improved
- A Trial lasts at most 3 days.
- Old versions are blocked after an important release, so everyone uses a working version.
- The app can run offline for up to 7 days between version checks.

### New
- Login with a license key bound to the computer (Machine ID).
- Responsive screen: works on laptops and large monitors; panels move into tabs on small screens.
- One-click setup package: installs by itself, adds Desktop and Start-menu shortcuts.
### Improved
- Much smaller download and install size (about 600 MB instead of 2–5 GB).
- New vocal-removal engine (MDX-Net), faster on computers without a graphics card.
- Temporary audio files are deleted after rendering to save disk space.
- In-app video preview is optional; videos can open in the normal video player.
### Fixed
- The setup window no longer pauses when you click inside it.
- Clear error message instead of nothing happening when the app cannot start.

### New
- Automatic male / female Khmer voice that matches the original speaker.
- All Gemini 3 models in the model list, with automatic switching when a model is busy.
- "Re-translate Selected" button and "Auto shorten long lines" option.
- Start without the black console window (KhmerDubStudio.exe).
### Improved
- Better translation: the whole video is read first (names and terms stay consistent),
  more context per line, pronouns match the speaker (បាទ / ចាស).
- Missing translations are retried automatically – no more silent lines.
- Quiet speech is recognised better; the language is detected from several parts of the video.
- Subtitles are no longer burned into the video; the picture is kept in original quality.
### Fixed
- Khmer voice was cut off at the end of long lines.
- "Cannot send a request" error when checking the Gemini API key.

### New
- Translate videos from any language into Khmer.
- Automatic language detection and speech recognition (Whisper).
- Translation with Google Gemini.
- Khmer voice-over (Piseth / Sreymom) synced to the original timing.
- Remove the original voice and keep music and sound effects.
- Review and edit every line before rendering; export .srt subtitles.
